sources.label: Arbitrum USDai contract and PYUSD reserve balance

reserveReview.rationale: The live USD.AI reserve index publishes a PYUSD sleeve plus GPU-backed infrastructure loans. On 2026-08-13, the share-bearing rows summed to 59.29384384% PYUSD and 40.70615616% across 18 active loans. The accounting is independently reconstructible from Arbitrum: PYUSD balanceOf(USDai) exactly matched the API's normalized PYUSD amount, LoanRouterV2 emits loan hashes and lifecycle events, and loanState(bytes32) exactly matched the API's outstanding principal for the sampled active loan. That verifies token balances and loan accounting, but not the off-chain GPU identity, appraisal, insurance, SPV structure, or legal enforceability; those remain issuer disclosures. Slice names remain aligned to the live adapter identities. Dependency adjudication retained: sUSDai is a serial wrapper of USDai, so the PYUSD look-through is inherited through the parent rather than modeled as a parallel dependency.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: USD.AI index shares aggregated by bucket and reconciled to Arbitrum PYUSD balance and LoanRouterV2 state, fetched 2026-08-13
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every accounting bucket is identified and its token or loan principal is reconstructible on-chain. Borrower addresses and loan state are public, but the physical GPU mapping, valuation, insurance, SPV structure, and enforceability behind the private-credit bucket remain issuer-described and are aggregated here into one reviewed exposure.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: sUSDai is a serial wrapper of USDai; this PYUSD slice is the look-through of the parent's backing. The PYUSD exposure is inherited through the reviewed serial wrapper edge to usdai-usd-ai (whose verified reserve envelope is 100% PYUSD) and is tracked on the parent asset, so the slice is not a separate parallel dependency link.
GPU infrastructure loans are private-credit positions, not tracked stablecoin dependencies.
